title: FBI Offers Reward for Most Wanted US Gangster
summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has announced a reward of $50,000 for information leading to the capture of Goldy Brar, an alleged leader of a gang based in North America. The FBI is seeking information on Brar's whereabouts and any potential associates. This development comes as part of the ongoing efforts to combat organized crime in the United States.
